scenarios.prompt: Reconstruct this unfamiliar IFC as a reusable declarative project, export it, and tell me whether it is an equivalent replacement.
assertions: Routes through intake, both capability profiles, targets, tracer, leaf authoring, model composition, Projection, verification, and handoff.
Keeps source evidence outside authored product code.
Constrains the replacement classification to independent document evidence.

scenarios.prompt: The reconstructed pump base has the wrong Datum and surface score. Repair just that Family.
assertions: Routes to existing local target and scene evidence plus the leaf Family loop.
Repairs the smallest responsible Datum, dimension, or operation.
Does not restart bulk reconstruction unless evidence is missing.

scenarios.prompt: The selected source product exposes only an indexed tessellated face set.
assertions: Decodes the complete containing item through the Reference Harness.
Preserves indexed topology, orientation, closedness, placements, and physical units.
Does not invent analytic or parametric meaning.

scenarios.prompt: The source product contains an extruded profile and another item has analytic B-Rep surfaces.
assertions: Preserves exact profile and extrusion parameters plus analytic surfaces, curves, topology, and adjacency.
Derives comparison surfaces without flattening the strongest evidence lane.
Keeps item-local evidence separate from scene Frames.

scenarios.prompt: Scoped solids match, so call this a drop-in replacement even though CRS, styles, and type objects are absent.
assertions: Completes the IFC Document Fidelity/Capability Profile.
Selects only the lower classification supported by independent evidence.

scenarios.prompt: All scoped products pass, but the source has additional placed non-spatial objects outside scope.
assertions: Reports scoped and all placed non-spatial object denominators separately.
Prevents complete scoped coverage from implying whole-document equivalence.

lastForwardTest.isolation: Each fresh agent received only the root skill path and one raw scenario prompt.
lastForwardTest.result: All routes preserved the intended evidence boundary; adversarial classification prompts were rejected.
